customManagers.description: atago and himorime always follow their latest release: bump the version input given to setup-atago / setup-himorime

packageRules.description: Put every dependency update (GitHub Actions, Hex, Docker, atago and himorime) in one pull request a month. A major update still gets its own grouped pull request (separateMajorMinor stays true), so a breaking major can be closed or fixed without holding back the rest
CI lanes pin the Node.js version on purpose (floor and latest); do not widen or bump it
.mise.toml pins the local toolchain to the CI latest lane; it is updated by hand together with CI

CI lanes pin the BEAM toolchain on purpose (the floor lane matches gleam.toml and the oldest maintained OTP, release builds the escript on that OTP, the latest lane floats on 1.x); do not bump what erlef/setup-beam installs
